items.rationale: Dismantling and refitting needed to place drying equipment is part of technical drying (5.2.7). The case 46 rate of about 90 per piece applies.
Technical drying is covered under 5.1(g)/5.2.7. Invoiced 7 days x about 45/day; case 46 revealed at least 287.
The claim calls this surcharge unexplained, so no itemised list exists. Under 7.4.4 a surcharge without an itemised list is not paid.
Standard mineral-wool shell, within threshold 7.14(c), on the repaired pipe. About 26 per piece.
Debris removal is covered under 5.2.1, but only the first charge for the same removal is paid. The drying invoice comes first, so this one is paid at about 60.
Re-levelling the substrate is making good within the damage area (5.2.6). Case 46 revealed at least 35.
Substrate reinstatement in the damage area counts as making good. No reference line exists, so I estimate about 40/m² x 2.78.
Creating the service opening needed to reach the leaking joint is covered under 5.2.6. Customary flat rate estimated.
90x90 is within the tile threshold of 7.14(d), so these reinstate the removed tiles. Estimated at an installed rate of about 65 per tile x 5.
Exceeds the 90x90 threshold, so 3.5(f) allows no payment at all. It also duplicates line 9 and is a betterment under 3.5(a).
Standard sanitary silicone for the reinstated tiling. About 13/m x 3.6, as in case 46.
Under 7.4.2 travel is paid once per contractor per document. Full rate is about 82.
Labour for the tiling and making-good work, at the full rate of about 90/h x 14. Case 46 revealed at least 1260.

items.description: Remove drywall and insulation wool in basement
items.rationale: Opening up within the basement damage area is covered under 5.2.6. Case 46 revealed drywall at 44-55 plus insulation at 44-48 as separate lines; combined here.

items.description: Remove damp plaster in basement rooms
items.rationale: Within the basement damage area and covered. About 29 per unit, as in case 46.
No damage was established in the attic, so 3.5(b) and 7.1.5 exclude it. The claim also calls this work unrelated.
This duplicates the disposal already charged on the drying invoice. Under 5.2.1 and 3.5(d) only the first charge is paid.
